g.text: A restarted replica votes from t0; it joins root votes once replay catches up
subscribe to live frames + data; verify and vote at once (votes need no history)
fetch the newest snapshot ≤ the newest RootCert
striped by height across all peers (block record + cert, §8.2);
verify certs and roots, write them to the local journal
replay at max speed; buffer live input
live input already counts toward votes
the replica joins root votes and is "caught up"
